exposure: ultrasound-guided suction using negative pressure, curettage, and percutaneous drainage
cohort: Five patients with rectus sheath hematoma who had undergone cesarean sections.
finding: The new treatment method of ultrasound-guided suction using negative pressure, curettage, and percutaneous drainage significantly reduced hematoma area and relieved abdominal pain in all five patients, with no detected complications at follow-up.
